item.title: Welcome
item.description: Hello there, I put random thoughts here in an effort to test out Working in Public. perhaps the only things worth reading right now are things under the following: writing The Way I Work v2 Outside of that you will be reading my thinking process notes and in that endeavor I wish you luck.

item.title: Brandon Boswell Year in Review
item.description: His 2022 Year in review Something about this spoke to me when I saw it. As time goes on you’ll forget much of a year. I like the idea of aggregating at multiple levels.

item.title: make an picture album of things that resonate to future vision
item.description: Summary The idea is that I can show gallery views on phone home screen. Body Me Tisha Family Friends Things that resonate with me Usually this feels pretty cheesy which is perfect because cheesy is an emotion and you recall things better if they are tied to emotions.

item.title: Spaced Repetition System
item.description: What am I doing with this? What I use this for is effectively my takeaways. Things that resonate with me. Ah Ha moments or key insights and learnings that I want to recall the specifics of so that they are committed to memory.

item.title: The practice of recording things that resonate with you
item.description: Summary When something resonates with me for whatever reason (something I think about later) I capture it in a quick note and tag it withresonate Body Encountered from a Cal Newport ...

item.title: Good example of book with spaced repitition
item.description: This article does the same thing that quantum country does to improve the retention. Though to a lesser extent in the long term tracking of it.

item.title: The Way I Work v2
item.description: Background The purpose of “the way I work” series of writing is to track what my process actually is. Personally I use it as a bit of an audit. My workflow goes through expansions and contractions naturally.

item.title: Capture
item.description: What? Capture for me is making sure that all ideas and requests go to one place so that I can process them at one time. From there they go to die. Few will survive and live on to the done column.

item.title: Caffeine alarm
item.description: Summary I like coffee. I drink much coffee. Drink coffee late I stay up. I set a daily alarm (currently at 2:30) as my “Last call” at this time should I want another cup I may go and grab my last cup.

item.title: Yearly
item.description: I don’t do much work on a yearly cadence. I find things like New Year’s Resolutions to be generally ineffective. Instead I use this as a social queue to sum up the year and take a step back to appreciate the progress I’ve made.
